/**
 * Scope names/descriptions supported by the Webflow OAuth authorization server
 */
export type ScopeCategory =
  (typeof SCOPE_CATEGORIES)[keyof typeof SCOPE_CATEGORIES];

export type ScopeCategoryKey = keyof typeof SCOPE_CATEGORIES;

/**
 * The universe of scopes supported by the Webflow OAuth authorization server.
 * Each value for 'key' must be globally unique
 *
 * Fields:
 * category - A logical grouping the scope belongs to. Used for hydrating the UI
 * authorizationResourceTypes - The type of resource the authorization associated with this scope can be assigned to (site/workspace)
 * name - The actual value for the scope. This is what must be passed in on the OAuth authorization request
 *        Must be globally unique
 * description - A human-readable string to display on the OAuth consent screen
 */

/**
 * Scope names/descriptions supported by the Webflow OAuth authorization server
 */
export type Scope = (typeof SCOPES)[keyof typeof SCOPES] & {
  featureFlag?: FeatureFlagName;
};

/**
 * Evaluates every distinct `featureFlag` referenced across `SCOPES` exactly
 * once, so a single operation (one grantability check, one catalog fetch)
 * makes one Statsig evaluation per flag instead of one per scope. Call this
 * once at the top of an operation and pass its result to `isScopeEnabled`.
 *
 * Passes an explicit empty identity so the check resolves the flag's
 * global default rather than inheriting whatever ambient request identity
 * (UserContext, WorkspaceContext, etc.) happens to be set — the scope
 * catalog and grantability checks run before a workspace is chosen, so
 * there is nothing to target on, and a per-user Statsig rule would
 * otherwise make the catalog caller-dependent instead of consistent.
 */
export function getEnabledFeatureFlagsForScopes(): Map<
  FeatureFlagName,
  boolean
> {
  const uniqueFlags = new Set(
    (Object.values(SCOPES) as Scope[])
      .map((scope) => scope.featureFlag)
      .filter((flag): flag is FeatureFlagName => Boolean(flag))
  );

  return new Map(
    Array.from(uniqueFlags, (flag) => [flag, getFeatureFlag(flag, {})])
  );
}

/**
 * Whether a scope is currently supported — visible in a catalog and
 * grantable on an authorization request. Scopes without a `featureFlag`
 * are always enabled; scopes with one are gated on the value already
 * resolved for it in `flagResults` (see `getEnabledFeatureFlagsForScopes`).
 */
export function isScopeEnabled(
  scope: Scope,
  flagResults: Map<FeatureFlagName, boolean>
): boolean {
  return !scope.featureFlag || Boolean(flagResults.get(scope.featureFlag));
}

// Compute reverse lookup here once, so it's not done for each function call
// e.g., 'sites:read' -> SCOPES.SITES_READ
const valueToScopeLookup: {
  [key: string]: Scope;
} = Object.values(SCOPES).reduce<Record<string, any>>((lookup, scope) => {
  lookup[scope.key] = scope;
  return lookup;
}, {});

// Compute lookup here once, so it's not done for each function call
// e.g., 'SITE' -> [SCOPES.SITES_READ, SCOPES.SITES_WRITE]
const categoryKeyToScopeLookup: {
  [categoryKey: string]: Scope[];
} = Object.values(SCOPES).reduce<Record<string, any>>((lookup, scope) => {
  const categoryKey = scope.category;
  if (!lookup[categoryKey]) {
    lookup[categoryKey] = [];
  }

  lookup[categoryKey].push(scope);

  return lookup;
}, {});

// Compute lookup here once, so it's not done for each function call
// e.g., 'SITE' => {'SITE' -> [SCOPES.SITES_READ, SCOPES.SITES_WRITE]}, etc.
export const authorizationTypeToCategoryKeyToScopeLookup: {
  [K in TokenAuthorizationResourceType]?: Partial<
    Record<ScopeCategoryKey, Scope[]>
  >;
} = Object.values(SCOPES).reduce<
  Partial<
    Record<
      TokenAuthorizationResourceType,
      Partial<Record<ScopeCategoryKey, Scope[]>>
    >
  >
>((lookup, scope) => {
  scope.authorizationResourceTypes.forEach((authorizationResourceType) => {
    // Ensure the resource type exists in the lookup
    if (!lookup[authorizationResourceType]) {
      lookup[authorizationResourceType] = {};
    }

    const categoryKey = scope.category as ScopeCategoryKey;

    // Ensure the category exists for this resource type
    if (!lookup[authorizationResourceType]![categoryKey]) {
      lookup[authorizationResourceType]![categoryKey] = [];
    }

    // Add the scope to the correct resource type and category
    lookup[authorizationResourceType]![categoryKey]!.push(scope);
  });

  return lookup;
}, {});

/**
 * Returns the Scope object with the matching value. Otherwise, throws an exception
 */
export function getScopeFromKey(key: string): Scope | null | undefined {
  return valueToScopeLookup[key];
}

/**
 * Returns an array of scopes matching the category. Otherwise, throws an exception
 */
export function getScopesForCategory(category: ScopeCategory): Scope[] {
  return categoryKeyToScopeLookup[category?.key] ?? [];
}
